title: Prism
subtitle: 116 emerald-cut diamonds, each one chosen, each one placed — assembled into a surface that moves like water and catches light like a mirror.
description: The grid is intentional. Emerald cuts are stacked tight in a mosaic — larger stones anchoring the centre rows, smaller ones tiling toward the edges — until the surface becomes a kind of diamond textile. The step facets of the emerald cut return light in flat, calm planes, so massed together they read less as sparkle than as a woven sheet of light that moves like water across the wrist. From across the room it registers simply as brightness; up close it resolves into precision, every stone placed. Set in eighteen-karat white gold.
